thread:
Sam L: Hey team, small problem — the orientation calendar invite shows 9:00 AM PT in the description but when I import the .ics into Outlook it lands at 5:00 PM UTC which clashes with another meeting. Anyone else seeing this?
Priya N: I saw that too. Outlook sometimes treats DTSTART with Z and ignores TZID. What does the .ics look like?
Sam L: Copied the relevant lines:
```
BEGIN:VEVENT
DTSTART:20260420T160000Z
DTEND:20260420T170000Z
TZID:America/Los_Angeles
SUMMARY:Redwood New Hire Orientation
END:VEVENT
```
Ethan R: Yup that's the classic Z+TZID mismatch. Calendar providers differ on whether Z (UTC) or TZID wins. Outlook desktop tends to use the Z time value.
Rachael (People Ops): Thanks for flagging — apologies! We schedule in PT but our calendar export added the Z stamp. @onboarding-bot can you regenerate the invite with DTSTART/TZID only (no trailing Z) and attach closed captions opt-in text? Also please send an APAC-friendly optional repeat.

onboarding-bot: Task queued  regenerating invite with TZ-only timestamps, adding APAC alternate, and posting recording link post-session.
Priya N: Quick workaround: in Outlook open the event > Meeting > Time Zones and set it to Pacific Time, then save. Or delete the event and accept the new one when sent.
Sam L: Ill try the manual TZ change. Will the session be recorded and where will captions end up? I'm CET so likely watch later.
Rachael (People Ops): Yes, every session is recorded. We'll upload the recording + automated captions and a short human-edited notes doc to the onboarding wiki (internal link: https://internal.redwood.com/onboarding/orientation). We aim to post within 1 hour after the session.
Ethan R: If folks in APAC want a different slot, react with :raising_hand: and we'll add a repeat next week.
Sam L: Removed the event and will wait for the fresh invite. Thanks all! :thumbsup:
Rachael (People Ops): New invite sent (should show 9:00 AM PDT now) and APAC repeat added for Friday 23:00 UTC. I posted the captions policy and opt-in language to the wiki as well.

onboarding-bot: Reminder set  recording will be posted to onboarding wiki after session.
Sam L: Received  invite looks correct now. Appreciate the quick fix.
